recording.title: Ala15 · 500 ps
recording.sampling: The first thermal frame is at 0.5 ps, followed by 1 ps, 2 ps and every 1 ps through 500 ps.
recording.source: Gas-phase paper replica 1 (r2), the first 500 ps of the initial 10 ns segment. The first 11 relaxation geometries are excluded.
recording.observables: Kinetic energy and temperature use the archived momenta. Whole-peptide DSSP and heavy-atom RMSD use the saved positions. The trajectory files contain no potential energies.
